active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: First frozen tri-scope baseline established in 688a: 674a/675a IV-only, 688a anchor-only, and 676a joint38 share the zero-center normalized-innovation AR flow recipe with rollout energy 0.2, channel-level energy 0.05, train samples 2, rollout steps 4, all train windows, no contrast, no AR1 prior. It is a real framework-lock baseline but not final deployable. 698b introduced the first promising successor data-object: innovation-score AR flow. 711a reran the active normalized-innovation IV and joint candidates under current diagnostics: 674a IV-only and 698b joint38 both score 7/11 and both pass population risk-state allocation, but neither is stress-deployable because lower-tail/regime under-inclusion remains.
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: The active normalized-innovation family is conditionally responsive but locally too narrow: both 674a IV-only and 698b joint38 pass population risk-state allocation, yet fail stress-readiness through lower-tail/regime under-inclusion in local cell/horizon slices.
last_result_summary: 711a reran 674a IV-only and 698b joint38 through the current 11-suite with split risk-state allocation. Both scored 7/11. 674a has conditional MAE reduction 10.16%, width/history rho 0.479, width/future rho 0.313, and 23 undercovered regime slices. 698b has conditional MAE reduction 9.77%, width/history rho 0.353, width/future rho 0.284, and 39 undercovered regime slices. Risk-readiness ranks 510a_splitpass higher as an IV-only stress control at 2/4, but active-family candidates remain 1/4 and not deployable.
next_step_recommendation: Run a frozen-framework coverage repair inside the normalized-innovation law. Target lower-tail/regime under-inclusion with a generic channel/horizon/state objective or dispersion allocation repair, without changing backend, sampler, or adding IV-specific cell rules. Keep 510a only as a control.
